reason: I hate when squeeze sauces separate and shoot out watery liquid over parathas, and having to order chutney from a separate website instead of Blinkit is inconvenient.
objection: Water and chutney usually separate in squeeze bottles, and that liquid will make tiffins completely soggy.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing positive reviews confirming the emulsion doesn't separate, and availability on Blinkit or Zepto for instant delivery.
